file_list_assertion: 24 accession-scoped RAW entries; all 24 map one-to-one to SDRF data files

group_mapping.shA/shC/shD: distinct OSER1 knockdown filename codes; code identity retained literally
group_mapping.1..4: four replicates per condition as paper Methods state

biological_evidence: Paper Figure 7 states the proteomic comparisons used U2OS cells with OSER1 knockdown or overexpression. PRIDE raw names give six groups, four replicates each. Cellosaurus CVCL_0042 supports U2OS donor female, 15Y, tibia, osteosarcoma. Exact shA/shC/shD sequence identities are not stated, so the source codes are preserved.
technical_evidence: Paper and PRIDE sample protocol state trypsin, Orbitrap Exploris 480, DIA, 350-1400 m/z MS1, 49 windows 13.7 Da with 1 Da overlap, and 27% NCE. PRIDE structured instrument dropdown says Q Exactive; the narrative Methods and EXPL raw filenames support Exploris 480 and are followed.
limitations: No shRNA target sequences were mapped to shA/shC/shD. The structured PRIDE instrument dropdown conflicts with the narrative and raw filenames.
